description: Lisa tab autocomplete (ghost text) and next-edit prediction with Tab-to-jump, powered by the vscode.lm API.
config.title: Lisa
config.tabCompletion.enabled: Enable Lisa tab autocomplete: show a ghost-text inline completion at the cursor, generated by a chat model.
config.tabCompletion.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds before Lisa asks the chat model for a tab completion after typing stops.
config.tabCompletion.maxPrefixLines: Number of lines before the cursor that are sent to the chat model as context.
config.tabCompletion.maxSuffixLines: Number of lines after the cursor that are sent to the chat model as context.
config.nextEdit.enabled: Enable Lisa next-edit prediction: after an edit, predict the next edit location in the same document and show a hint that Tab can jump to.
config.nextEdit.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds before Lisa asks the chat model to predict the next edit after typing stops.
config.model.family: Language model family used by Lisa (for example 'gpt-4o'). Leave empty to use the first available model.
colors.nextEdit.background: Background color of the predicted next-edit line decorated by Lisa.
